meta.001: MarketVision builds technology to connect markets and give businesses a clearer view of their operations.
meta.002: Interlocking cobalt and metal frames representing connection and visibility
copy.007: We build technology that makes businesses easier to find and gives them a clearer view of their operations.
copy.017: Our aim is to connect African markets and improve visibility: making businesses easier to find and giving them a clearer view of their operations.
copy.018: We develop commerce platforms, logistics systems and tools that turn vehicle and device data into useful information.
access.004: Illustration of a business showroom, product collections and direct enquiry
copy.021: An editorial illustration of a business showroom, with three geometric objects arranged as collections and a direct enquiry panel. It is a conceptual illustration, not a product screenshot.
copy.028: Product showrooms for farms, factories and artisans. Buyers can explore what suppliers offer, then enquire about buying in small quantities or in bulk.
access.006: Illustration of available transport capacity, a shared route and shipment updates
copy.035: A freight vehicle with available cargo space connects to a private network, then to a shipment update card. Precise route lines and a lock symbol convey controlled sharing and shipment visibility without depicting real locations or shipment data. This is a conceptual illustration, not a product screenshot.
copy.040: Transporters share available vehicle space and routes with brokers and shippers. For agreed shipments, they can share progress updates privately with the people involved.
copy.046: We bring the same expertise to consulting and software development in e-commerce, logistics and IoT telematics.
copy.047: We assess workflows, define requirements and evaluate technology choices against the business problem.
copy.048: We design and develop product catalogues, discovery tools and the workflows behind enquiries and orders.
copy.049: Systems for vehicle availability, capacity, shipment coordination and progress updates between transporters, brokers and shippers.
copy.050: Software that brings vehicle and device data into the systems people use to monitor operations and make decisions.
copy.052: Our work starts with how businesses buy, sell and move goods. That understanding guides the systems we design and develop.
copy.054: Map how work is handled, where information is missing and what the people using the system need.
copy.055: Establish the users, workflows and information the software needs to support.
